subject: general
question: According to the Airports Authority of India (AAI) data for April 2026, which airport emerged as India’s second-busiest airport specifically in the **domestic passenger traffic** segment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru Airport**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Data from the **Airports Authority of India (AAI)** revealed that **Bengaluru airport** overtook **Mumbai airport** in domestic passenger traffic for the month of **April 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• In **April**, **Bengaluru airport** handled **3.28 million domestic passengers**, making it the **second-busiest domestic airport** in India.
 
• During the same period, **Mumbai airport** (Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport) handled **2.89 million domestic passengers**.
 
• **Mumbai** recorded a **12% year-on-year decline** in domestic passenger traffic, while **Bengaluru** saw only a marginal **0.8% drop**.
 
• The growth in **Bengaluru** allowed it to displace **Mumbai** from its long-standing rank in the domestic segment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Despite losing its rank in domestic traffic, **Mumbai** retained its edge as the country's **second-busiest airport overall** (domestic + international), handling **4 million total passengers** compared to Bengaluru's **3.68 million**.
 
• **Bengaluru** had briefly led **Mumbai** in domestic traffic previously during certain months of the **Covid-hit years** of **2020 and 2021**.
 
• The newly operational **Navi Mumbai International Airport** is now absorbing incremental domestic growth from the **Mumbai Metropolitan Region**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Mumbai airport** faces **slot saturation pressure** due to its **single-runway system**, which restricts further expansion of domestic flights.
 
• By the **early to mid-2030s**, **Navi Mumbai airport** is projected to handle more flights and passengers than the main **Mumbai airport** as its operations expand.
